questions.question: Explain why debtors are an asset and creditors a liability, and name the source document and journal for a credit purchase.
questions.expected_answer: Debtors owe money to the business, which will come in, so they are an asset. The business owes creditors money, which must be paid out, so creditors are a liability. Source document: the original invoice received from the supplier. Journal: the creditors journal (CJ).

questions.question: Analyse in the accounting equation: (a) trading stock bought on credit R8 000; (b) stationery bought on credit R600; (c) equipment bought on credit R3 500; (d) paid a creditor R5 000 by EFT.
questions.expected_answer: (a) Assets (trading stock) +8 000; liabilities (creditors) +8 000. (b) Owner's equity -600 (stationery expense); liabilities +600. (c) Assets (equipment) +3 500; liabilities +3 500. (d) Assets (bank) -5 000; liabilities (creditors) -5 000; owner's equity not affected.

questions.question: Total the effects of the four transactions above and prove that the equation balances. How much does Ridgeview owe in total?
questions.expected_answer: Assets: 8 000 + 3 500 - 5 000 = +6 500. Owner's equity: -600. Liabilities: 8 000 + 600 + 3 500 - 5 000 = +7 100. Check: -600 + 7 100 = 6 500 = change in assets. Ridgeview owes BuildMart R3 000 + Office Hub R600 + Toolquip R3 500 = R7 100.
